stories.headline: Block Releases Speech-Only Conversational Model Dessa
stories.blurb: Dessa bypasses text conversion by training directly on audio, yielding natural speech patterns and prosody.

stories.headline: Technical Analysis of Apple's 20-Billion Parameter On-Device AI
stories.blurb: New architectural insights reveal how Apple runs a 20B model locally using flash memory optimization.

stories.blurb: Domain-specific legacy neural networks still outperform general-purpose frontier LLMs on specialized medical imaging diagnostics.

stories.blurb: A joint assessment examined potential alignment risks and emergent behavioral issues in Anthropic's frontier model.

stories.blurb: SpaceX closed a $40 billion debt facility specifically focused on expanding its AI chip supply and compute capabilities.

stories.headline: Qualcomm's Oryon Microarchitecture Analyzed in Detail

stories.headline: Goose Programming Language Introduced for Systems Engineering
stories.blurb: Goose enters the language ecosystem with a focus on combining low-level systems execution performance with modern safety guarantees.
